annotations.title: Get Zillow tax history for a property

description: Year-by-year property-tax record for a property: tax paid, assessed value, and the year-over-year change rates. Sourced from the homedetails page. Useful for spotting reassessment jumps or comparing tax burdens across properties. For some listings (commonly non-Showcase) Zillow omits the history from the server-rendered page; then `events` is empty and an explanatory `note` is returned — distinct from a genuine no-history.
name: zillow_get_tax_history
title: Get Zillow tax history for a property
